title: Low-Rank Frequency Convolution and Noise-Range Augmentation for Real-Time Pitch Estimation on Edge Devices
abstract: arXiv:2609.23340v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pitch estimation on an edge device is constrained in three ways at once. The model must be small, it must stay accurate when the input is noisy, and one frame must be produced inside the frame period. In this report the Frequency Convolution Network (FrCN) of our earlier work is factored into a low-rank form. The number of parameters is reduced by 35.9%, from 17,787 to 11,397, and accuracy is not reduced, either in domain or on two corpora the model was never trained on. The range of the noise used during training is also shown to dominate the architecture in setting how the model behaves when the interference is severe. When the training noise floor is lowered from +6.02 dB to -20 dB, 0.35 points of clean RPA50 are lost and RPA50 at -20 dB is raised from 2.44 to 22.41. translated_title: 面向边缘设备实时音高估计的低秩频率卷积与噪声范围增强
translated_abstract: 边缘设备上的音高估计同时受到三方面限制：模型必须足够小、必须在输入含噪时保持准确、并且必须在一个帧周期内产出一帧结果。本报告将我们早期工作中的频率卷积网络分解为低秩形式，参数量减少了35.9%，从17,787降至11,397，且无论在域内数据还是在两个模型从未训练过的语料库上，准确率均未下降。报告还表明，训练时所使用噪声的范围在决定模型遭受严重干扰时的表现方面，比架构本身更具主导作用。当训练噪声底从+6.02 dB降低到-20 dB时，干净信号下的RPA50仅损失0.35个百分点，而-20 dB下的RPA50从2.44提升至22.41。这一效应比所测得的任何架构效应大约大两个数量级。此外，研究发现TDNN-F中使用的半正交约束是多余的。
tldr: 该论文将频率卷积网络分解为低秩形式，使参数量减少35.9%且不损失精度，并发现训练噪声范围对模型抗噪性能的影响比架构设计大约两个数量级，从而在边缘设备上实现了实时且抗噪的音高估计。
en_tdlr: The paper factors the Frequency Convolution Network into a low-rank form, reducing parameters by 35.9% without accuracy loss, and shows that the training noise range dominates architecture in noise robustness by about two orders of magnitude, enabling real-time pitch estimation on edge devices.
